inventive_nucleus: A bioresorbable polymer locking mechanism is integrated into a self-expanding nitinol mesh to prevent septal occluder device embolization.

claim_versions.claim: A self-expanding nitinol mesh is integrated into a septal occluder device, wherein the mesh is designed to prevent septal occluder device embolization by interacting with the septal surface, and wherein the mesh is expandable to a diameter of at least 10 mm.
